```{r}
# Implementing statistically equivalent signature with my data
test_df = split_dab_df_list[[10]] %>% select(-c(Conc., Replicates)) %>% mutate_at("target_vector", as.factor)

test_folds = createFolds(test_df$target_vector, k = 5)

mxm_train = test_df[-test_folds[[1]], ]
mxm_test = test_df[test_folds[[1]], ]

mxm_default_mod = SES(
  target = "target_vector",
  dataset = mxm_train,
  max_k = 3,
  threshold = 0.1,
  test = 'testIndMultinom',
  ini = NULL,
  wei = NULL,
  user_test = NULL,
  hash = TRUE,
  hashObject = NULL,
  ncores = 1
)

mxm_default_mod@selectedVars
SelectedVars_names<-colnames(mxm_train[mxm_default_mod@selectedVars])
SelectedVars_names

SelectedVars_ordered <- colnames(mxm_train[mxm_default_mod@selectedVarsOrder])
SelectedVars_ordered

mxm_default_mod@signatures

perm_ses_model = perm.ses(target = "target_vector",
                          dataset = mxm_train,
                          R = 999,
                          max_k = 3,
                          threshold = 0.05,
                          test = 'permMultinom',
                          ini = NULL,
                          wei = NULL,
                          user_test = NULL,
                          hash = FALSE,
                          hashObject = NULL,
                          ncores = 1)

# cv.ses
mxm_mod_ses_1 = ses.model(target = as.matrix(mxm_train$target_vector),
                          dataset = as.matrix(mxm_train),
                          wei = NULL,
                          sesObject = mxm_default_mod,
                          test = 'testIndMultinom')
```
